description: Schema for extracting structured data from an invoice document.

invoice_date.description: The date when the invoice was issued. Format: YYYY-MM-DD.

due_date.description: The date by which the invoice payment is due. Format: YYYY-MM-DD.

vendor.description: Information about the vendor, supplier, or seller.

name.description: The name of the vendor or supplier.

address.description: The full address of the vendor.

email.description: The email address of the vendor for billing or contact.

bill_to.description: Information about the entity being billed.

name.description: The name of the entity being billed.

line_items.description: A list of individual items or services on the invoice.

description.description: A description of the item or service.

quantity.description: The quantity of the item or service.

unit_price.description: The price per unit of the item or service.

amount.description: The total amount for this line item (quantity * unit_price).

subtotal.description: The sum of all line item amounts before taxes and discounts.

tax.description: Details about the tax applied to the invoice.

rate.description: The tax rate as a percentage (e.g., 8.875 for 8.875%).

total_amount_due.description: The grand total amount due for the invoice, including subtotal and tax.
